note: Rewritten from the Diagnostic characters section of Chhotani's Fauna of India, the original in English; that section gives the morphology and measurements of each caste, not key couplet sentences. OCR problems: the original 08-0.10 mm lacks its leading zero, and spellings such as subrectangualr are wrong; whatever is legible in the original is transcribed as it stands.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow to yellowish brown. Body length 5.40—7.0 mm. Head capsule nearly rectangular; head length including mandibles 3.0—3.6 mm, maximum head width 1.23—1.70 mm. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 16—17-segmented; with 16 segments segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3, segment 4 shortest; with 17 segments segment 2 almost twice as long as segment 3, segment 3 shortest, apical segment oval. Labrum ligulate, the sides nearly parallel. Mandibles sword-shaped, robust, the apex broadly pointed and incurved, more than half the head length; the left mandible with a distinct and sharp marginal tooth on the lower margin of the apical third (mandible-tooth index 0.34—0.43 mm), the right mandible with a minute vestigial tooth at the middle of the distal part. Postmentum nearly rectangular. Pronotum saddle-shaped, distinctly narrower than the head width, anterior margin with a distinct notch in the middle; maximum head width 1.23—1.70 mm, posterior margin weakly to deeply concave. Abdomen long. Cerci and styli 0.08—0.10 mm long (given as 08-0.10 in the original).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule yellowish brown; antennae yellowish white, becoming darker towards the apex. Body length 3.80—5.30 mm. Head capsule nearly rectangular, maximum head width 1.33—1.63 mm. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 17-segmented, rarely 18 (segment 4 incompletely separated); segment 2 distinctly longer than segment 3, segment 3 shortest, apical segment oval. Pronotum saddle-shaped, wider than long, maximum length 0.35—0.40 mm, maximum width 0.70—0.80 mm, posterior margin broadly concave. Abdomen nearly spherical. Cerci 0.10—0.13 mm, styli 0.10 mm. Minor worker: similar to the major worker but smaller, head capsule slightly oval, antennae 16-segmented.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Castes known: soldier and worker; the alate is not described.
